name: Крупные обломки — наклонное ядро
subject: ONE destructible natural gray rock resource asset, angular stepped fused voxel geology, warm-gray primary stone with a few pale coarse mineral patches, dark-gray wide fracture seams and restrained FLAT olive moss color patches attached to stone surfaces (no growing plants). Large Minecraft-style cubic masses with chunky material pixels, no tiny rubble confetti, smooth beveled stone or photoreal texture. No soil, ground, grass, pedestal or landscape. This is ONE variant, not a family gallery or destruction sequence. All five copies show the same arrangement of main masses, cracks and separate fragments. Second destruction-stage broken large rock. One slanted coarse wedge core still upright with a major missing upper corner, TWO large split pieces at its low side, fresh break seam along tilted ridge. Significant standing remnant, not intact high spire or final tiny debris.
caption: Один вариант соответствующей стадии разрушения: пять ракурсов без земли, ландшафта и подписи.
